races.name: Lisburn And Castlereagh City Council 3-Y-O Hurdle
races.verdict:
KENOUGH can build on his promising hurdle debut third at Punchestown and prove too strong for penalised Killarney winner Cite Florale. Gordon Elliott's Contador was well behind the selection at Punchestown but should improve and get closer to him this time.

  1. KENOUGH (FR)
  2. CITE FLORALE (FR)
  3. CONTADOR

races.name: Lough Construction Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict:
Hurdling debutant SKERRY HILL looks a fine prospect and can maintain his unbeaten sequence. Young Rebel is the pick of those with experience and can give him most to think about.

  1. SKERRY HILL (IRE)
  2. YOUNG REBEL (IRE)
  3. MICROSCOPE

races.name: Kildress Plumbing Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
RADIATOR SPRINGS again shaped like a very well-treated mare when fourth of 18 at Listowel on her return last month and gets the nod to confirm the promise of that run faced with a seemingly ideal test. The selection's stablemate Lieber Nicc hasn't been seen since winning this race last year, but that is no bad thing given he's plainly very capable fresh and must be taken seriously in his bid to repeat the feat from a 10 lb higher mark. Ben Hur remains unexposed and completes the shortlist.

  1. RADIATOR SPRINGS (IRE)
  2. LIEBER NICC (IRE)
  3. BEN HUR (IRE)

races.name: Start Your Racing TV Free Trial Now Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
DINOLAND and Ladies Well have both been thriving of late and look the pair to concentrate on, with marginal preference for the former given the return to chasing is very much in his favour. Charlie Luciano is likely to give it another good go, too.

  1. DINOLAND (FR)
  2. LADIES WELL (IRE)
  3. CHARLIE LUCIANO (IRE)

races.name: BetVictor, Remembering Envoi Allen Champion Chase (Grade 1)
races.verdict:
A case for 6 of the 7 can easily be made in this open early-season Grade 1. BANBRIDGE has had the benefit of a recent run and stays 3m well, so is awarded the tentative vote. Heart Wood scaled new heights in 2025/26 and represents a stable in excellent form, so he's feared most.

  1. BANBRIDGE (IRE)
  2. HEART WOOD (FR)
  3. AFFORDALE FURY (IRE)

races.name: Racing Post Chase (Grade 2)
races.verdict:
KOKTAIL DIVIN is selected to make light of a Grade 1 penalty and deny Gordon Elliott a fifth successive win in this Grade 2 contest. Jack Kennedy seemingly prefers Jacob's Ladder to Kala Conti from the Elliott pair and that 7-y-o might be the one to give Henry de Bromhead's charge most to think about.

  1. KOKTAIL DIVIN (FR)
  2. JACOB'S LADDER (IRE)
  3. KALA CONTI (FR)

races.name: SIS, Proud Sponsors Of Irish Racing (Pro/Am) Flat Race
races.verdict:
UNCLE PAD makes obvious appeal having been purchased by top connections for £310,000 after easily winning his sole outing in points, so he's put forward as the answer. Bravemans Call was much improved from his debut when runner-up to a well-touted Mullins newcomer at Listowel last month and is clear pick of those with experience. Malpaso is out of a bumper winner and any market support for him would be worth noting.

  1. UNCLE PAD (IRE)
  2. BRAVEMANS CALL (IRE)
  3. MALPASO (IRE)

races.name: Grundon Novices' Handicap Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
With the form of his latest second working out well, MEDIA MOGUL may go one better in spite of his quirks. Well-related Secret Sniper is likely to be a danger if fit and well, while Beau Quali looks an interesting each-way contender with a run under his belt.

  1. MEDIA MOGUL (IRE)
  2. SECRET SNIPER
  3. BEAU QUALI (FR)

races.name: Ascot Underwriting Novices' Limited Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
JET TO VEGAS has been lightly raced in recent seasons and bounced right back to his best following 4 months off when defeating a next-time-out winner at Market Rasen 5 weeks ago. His very best form over fences has come in small fields and he could well be worthy of siding with to follow up. Dance And Glance and Glynn Brae are 2 interesting chase debutants, though, whilst The Gray Ghost appeals as the type to come forward from his Uttoxeter chase debut second.

  1. JET TO VEGAS (IRE)
  2. DANCE AND GLANCE
  3. THE GRAY GHOST (IRE)

races.name: Sodexo Live! Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
This looks wide open but VANDERPOEL was most progressive before faring best of the prominent runners in the Grand Annual so could be the answer if ready to go. Race-fit trio Aeros Luck, Haas Boy and Gore Point head the dangers.

  1. VANDERPOEL (IRE)
  2. AEROS LUCK (IRE)
  3. HAAS BOY (FR)

races.name: Sodexo Live! Regal Encore Handicap Chase (Premier Handicap) (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
An open-looking renewal in which it could pay to side with the hat-trick seeking TAPLEY. He's thrived upon joining the Moore stable under this rider in recent weeks and with the return to further unlikely to be an issue, particularly on a right-handed track, he could well put his fitness edge over the majority to very good use. Califet en Vol, Viroflay and last year's winner Henry's Friend head the dangers, with Transmission also worth a look in a change of headgear.

  1. TAPLEY
  2. CALIFET EN VOL (IRE)
  3. VIROFLAY (FR)

races.name: 1st Class Logistics Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
NO WAY JAY looks interesting on the pick of his bumper form and could be worth another chance back on a right-handed track. He's narrowly preferred to fellow hurdling debutant Sportingsilvermine, who arrives with an appealing profile, while Babs is likely to give another good account with experience and fitness on her side.

  1. NO WAY JAY (IRE)
  2. SPORTINGSILVERMINE (IRE)
  3. BABS

races.name: Lavazza Handicap Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Unexposed 5-y-o TRUSTINTIMES looks to have plenty in his favour and is fancied to make it 2-2 over C&D. The dangers are headed by Hamlet's Night, who's weighted to go close under a good-value claimer. Interesting stable-switcher Messerschmitt, Fasol and Moveit Like Minnie are others to consider.

  1. TRUSTINTIMES
  2. HAMLET'S NIGHT (IRE)
  3. MESSERSCHMITT (IRE)

races.name: Ascot Colts And Fillies' Club Open NH Flat Race (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Penalised pair LORD CHURCHILL and Saint Argente make most appeal. The latter impressed in coming from last to first at Warwick but the former accounted for a next-time-out winner in a good time on his debut at Wincanton and edges the vote. Colombe D'or is a well-bred newcomer from a yard in excellent order and would have to enter calculations if supported in the betting.

  1. LORD CHURCHILL (IRE)
  2. SAINT ARGENTE (IRE)
  3. COLOMBE D'OR (FR)

races.name: 6 Horses Challenge At bet365 Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Irish raider MINELLA HOLLOW sets a good standard back in calmer waters and is taken to defy a penalty. Of the opposition, Loopy Mag is an Irish-point winner who is presumably the choice of Danny McMenamin and needs a close look in the betting on his Rules debut for a yard starting to hit a bit of form, while Measure Of A Man is another to note.

  1. MINELLA HOLLOW (IRE)
  2. LOOPY MAG (FR)
  3. MEASURE OF A MAN (IRE)

races.name: Position Payout At bet365 Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
PALAMON would surely have followed up with a clear passage at Plumpton recently so a 2 lb rise looks within range. Tanking Along is an uncomplicated sort who is fit and in form so he's on the shortlist, with Kahavari also of some interest.

  1. PALAMON (IRE)
  2. TANKING ALONG (IRE)
  3. KAHAVARI (FR)

races.name: bet365 Montagu Mares' Hurdle (Listed) (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
KATEIRA had the race left at her mercy when successful in this corresponding event 12 months ago. She should follow up on merit this time around, with La Conquiere the pick of the remainder on last year's early-season form.

  1. KATEIRA
  2. LA CONQUIERE (FR)
  3. WATAMU

races.name: bet365 Hurdle (Grade 2) (Registered As The West Yorkshire Hurdle) (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
TAKE NO CHANCES and Strong Leader finished first and second in this a year ago and they may well come to the fore again. The latter was a neck too strong that day but the former is slightly better off at the weights, which just tilts the scales.

  1. TAKE NO CHANCES (IRE)
  2. STRONG LEADER
  3. PAGGANE

races.name: bet365 Charlie Hall Chase (Grade 2) (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
PIC D'ORHY has an excellent record fresh and was beaten only by another high-class sort in this last year, so he should take plenty of beating on his first run for the champion trainer. Former winner The Real Whacker has looked rejuvenated for his red-hot yard so is next best.

  1. PIC D'ORHY (FR)
  2. THE REAL WHACKER (IRE)
  3. TWINJETS (IRE)

races.name: Each Way Extra At bet365 Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
RACE TO BASE is the least exposed of the quartet and may well make a winning reappearance. Klitschko and Filibustering have race fitness in the bank, and both look credible dangers in a race that's likely to be very tactical (no obvious pace on paper).

  1. RACE TO BASE (IRE)
  2. KLITSCHKO
  3. FILIBUSTERING

races.name: bet365 Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Claims can be made for all 4 but SLEDGEHAMMER looks the obvious one after landing a gamble in good style for new connections at Hexham 3 weeks ago. Paddy O'Mahler is second choice.

  1. SLEDGEHAMMER (IRE)
  2. PADDY O'MAHLER (IRE)
  3. UPFORDEBATE (IRE)

races.name: Ben Arthur's Bothy Of Arrochar EBF 'National Hunt' Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
An interesting opener. Course bumper winner THE SKECHER gets a narrow vote over the unbeaten Majordomo. Sandy Thomson's King Kubala also created a good impression when winning his bumper in the spring.

  1. THE SKECHER (FR)
  2. MAJORDOMO (FR)
  3. KING KUBALA (IRE)

races.name: BSB Structural Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
DIDNTGOTWENTY hasn't looked back since fitted with cheekpieces and he gets a confident vote to resume winning ways with the form of his excellent reappearance Perth second having been boosted by the wide-margin win of the third. Torosay came home second in this 12 months ago and could again fill the same spot, while chasing newcomer The Grey Venture, an Irish points winner, also needs considering.

  1. DIDNTGOTWENTY (IRE)
  2. TOROSAY (IRE)
  3. THE GREY VENTURE (IRE)

races.name: United Council Of Racecourse Bookmakers Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
KNOMOREDIAMONDS gets the nod for a stable who have saddled several to win on reappearance in recent weeks. Hat-trick-seeking Blue Las is feared most from her lower hurdle mark.

  1. KNOMOREDIAMONDS (FR)
  2. BLUE LAS
  3. THE G WIZARD (IRE)

races.name: Bet With Rails Bookmakers On Course Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
WOLFBURG was in fine form when last seen in the spring and is taken to return in style and complete a hat-trick here. Halftheworldaway rates an interesting prospect now going chasing and could prove the main danger ahead of Tommy Combats and Moon Phases.

  1. WOLFBURG (IRE)
  2. HALFTHEWORLDAWAY (IRE)
  3. TOMMY COMBATS (IRE)

races.name: '3B Crane Hire Trick Or Trot' Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
GINGER MAIL isn't the force he was when winning this corresponding event in 2022 but has dropped far enough in the weights to be given a chance. Inappropriate could be a serious threat back down in grade over hurdles. Liberty Coach and Pure Gold also need a close look in a competitive renewal.

  1. GINGER MAIL (FR)
  2. INAPPROPRIATE (IRE)
  3. LIBERTY COACH

races.name: Bet With On Course Bookmakers Novices' Limited Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Dan Skelton's TALES OF BRAVERY appeals as one who should have a bright future over fences and he's preferred to Irish raider Soldante.

  1. TALES OF BRAVERY (IRE)
  2. SOLDANTE (IRE)
  3. HE'S BRESILIAN

races.name: Hogmanay Ball At Western House Hotel Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
C&D winner CK O'MARA remains completely unexposed as a stayer and proved his effectiveness away from the mud when fourth at Perth when last seen in April. There ought to be more to come from Mike Smith's 5-y-o this season and he earns the vote. Likeable mare Bollin Matilda, Coventry (back up in trip) and Anamanda are a trio of others to consider.

  1. CK O'MARA (IRE)
  2. BOLLIN MATILDA
  3. COVENTRY (IRE)

races.name: ARC All Weather Bonus Is Back Handicap (Div 1)
races.verdict:
VOLENTI produced a promising effort over C&D earlier in the month and a reproduction of that form might be enough to see him end his lengthy losing run. Launceston and Book of Life might prove the biggest dangers.

  1. VOLENTI (IRE)
  2. LAUNCESTON (IRE)
  3. BOOK OF LIFE

races.name: ARC All Weather Bonus Is Back Handicap (Div 2)
races.verdict:
The ex-Irish OPPENHEIMER lurks on a handy mark and might be worth chancing having joined the James Owen yard. Lili Marleen has to be respected on the back of last week's C&D win, with Desert Charm also on the shortlist.

  1. OPPENHEIMER (IRE)
  2. LILI MARLEEN (GER)
  3. DESERT CHARM

races.name: All-Weather Championship Is Back Nursery (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
NATIONAL HONOUR failed to justify a short price on nursery bow last week but he remains with potential and can make amends back on all-weather. Talamon might prove the biggest threat switched to this company, with Tiora Time taken to complete the 1-2-3.

  1. NATIONAL HONOUR (IRE)
  2. TALAMON (USA)
  3. TIORA TIME

races.name: AW Trials Day - Lingfield 2nd Jan 2027 Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
ALWAYS SUNNY shaped well on her debut when runner-up at Newcastle when not enjoying the smoothest of runs and can build on it here and go one better. Maneuver unseated at the start on her Newcastle reappearance but remains with potential and rates the chief threat ahead of Hugo Palmer's newcomer Francesca's Dream.

  1. ALWAYS SUNNY (IRE)
  2. MANEUVER
  3. FRANCESCA'S DREAM

races.name: Midnite Ain't Your Grandad's Bookie Handicap
races.verdict:
A useful handicap which seems sure to make for strong form. PRINCLING shaped encouragingly back down in trip after 3 months off (gelded since in interim) when third in a minor event at Ascot last time and looks on a good mark now returning to handicap company. Fellow 3-y-o Portcullis won both his starts back in the spring and remains open to significant improvement, while there could easily be more to come from Murashah, who's 2 from 2 for Ed Bethell.

  1. PRINCLING
  2. PORTCULLIS
  3. MURASHAH (IRE)

races.name: AWC Finals Day At Newcastle 26th March EBF 'Confined' Restricted Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
CHAPEL DOWN shaped a more clear-cut second best than the end result suggests at Brighton on his most recent outing and is well worth another chance to build on his debut promise. Palms Oasis is an obvious threat with further progress on the cards, while Annie Hall and Bondy Boy are a couple of interesting newcomers to note in the betting.

  1. CHAPEL DOWN
  2. PALMS OASIS
  3. ANNIE HALL

races.name: Make The Move To Midnite Handicap
races.verdict:
It could be worth chancing HAMMER THE HAMMER, who often keeps much better company and the return to all-weather may rekindle him. This does look competitive, though, with Bolo Neighs and Kind Touch heading the dangers.

  1. HAMMER THE HAMMER (IRE)
  2. BOLO NEIGHS (IRE)
  3. KIND TOUCH (IRE)

races.name: Midnite A Next Generation Betting App Handicap
races.verdict:
None of these can be ruled out but TOPTIME rates just the pick of the weights and can add to his very good record round here now reverted to the minimum trip. Recent Bath winner Hi Lord heads the list of dangers ahead of Guernsey Angel and Midnight Call.

  1. TOPTIME
  2. HI LORD
  3. GUERNSEY ANGEL

races.name: Midnite: Built For 2026 Not 2006 Apprentice Handicap
races.verdict:
NESWICK advanced her form in a first-time visor when getting off the mark over C&D recently and with few miles still on the clock she can defy a 2 lb rise. Sisterandbrother is a danger on the back of a good C&D second, while Chambers would also have to be considered if turning out again under a penalty for his victory here on Thursday.

  1. NESWICK
  2. SISTERANDBROTHER
  3. CHAMBERS (IRE)

races.name: Prestige Vehicles Handicap (Div 1)
races.verdict:
SPACE PARTY has made a good start in handicaps and can back up a positive effort at C&D last week to get off the mark. Almarada Prince can go well on the back of his Pontefract win, whilst Underwriter wasn't seen to best effect last time and still lurks on a handy mark.

  1. SPACE PARTY (IRE)
  2. ALMARADA PRINCE (IRE)
  3. UNDERWRITER (FR)

races.name: Prestige Vehicles Handicap (Div 2)
races.verdict:
Last year's winner DASHING DICK found only a fellow well-handicapped rival (who has gone in again since) too strong at Leicester on his most recent start 2 weeks ago and he makes plenty of appeal at the foot of the weights. Salisbury eyecatcher Lyra Lea is still lightly raced at sprint trips and may emerge as the leading danger, with Purest Time and Wodao completing the shortlist.

  1. DASHING DICK (IRE)
  2. LYRA LEA
  3. PUREST TIME

races.name: Cologne's 65 Preis Von Europa British EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
IBTEKAR made a promising start to her career at Ascot at the beginning of the month and gets the nod over Next Best, who also displayed promise on her debut. Market confidence behind newcomers So This Is Love, La Conquista and any of the William Haggas trio would also bring them firmly into calculations.

  1. IBTEKAR (IRE)
  2. NEXT BEST
  3. SO THIS IS LOVE

races.name: Dusseldorf's Henkel 169 German Oaks Handicap
races.verdict:
A useful handicap. BEAGLE BAY let favourite backers down at York earlier in the month but is probably worth another chance given how well his Sandown defeat of Raammee in June has worked out. Returning Gosden stable handicap newcomer Lighting Thunder brings obvious unexposed potential. Charlie Appleby pair Man of Vision and Fort Rock are also 3-y-os with positive profiles, while River King scored in good style at Doncaster last weekend.

  1. BEAGLE BAY (FR)
  2. LIGHTING THUNDER
  3. MAN OF VISION

races.name: Hurworth Bloodstock Horris Hill Stakes (Group 3)
races.verdict:
Aidan O'Brien can strengthen his grip on the trainers' championship courtesy of BENGAL TIGER, who impressed in listed company at Doncaster last weekend. Lex Victoria and Jassas were both beaten only 4½ lengths in Group 1s here earlier in the month and rate the chief form threats in a Group 3 containing several likely improvers.

  1. BENGAL TIGER (IRE)
  2. LEX VICTORIA (IRE)
  3. JASSAS

races.name: British Stallion Studs EBF Montrose Fillies' Stakes (Fillies' Listed)
races.verdict:
A race which to a large degree revolves around HAVEN, who will be very hard to beat if in anything like the same form as when second in the Group 1 Fillies' Mile over C&D 3 weeks ago. Fellow Ballydoyle representative So Lovely also brings top-level form to the table, while Sizzling Affair looked good when comfortably seeing off the reopposing Trapped Goddess.

  1. HAVEN (IRE)
  2. SO LOVELY (USA)
  3. SIZZLING AFFAIR (IRE)

races.name: German Group One Racecourses James Seymour Stakes (Listed)
races.verdict:
A wide-open contest in which narrow preference is for WHITE BIRCH, who made an encouraging start for Jamie Osborne after an absence when third in a good-quality listed event at Windsor (form franked) and can thwart recent York scorer Grey Cuban. Both Nahraan and Arabian Light also need factoring in.

  1. WHITE BIRCH
  2. GREY CUBAN
  3. NAHRAAN

races.name: Idee 158. German Derby In Hamburg Nursery
races.verdict:
This is wide open. Tim Easterby's WELLS FARGOS ENVOY appeals as a likely improver now going into nurseries with her stamina unlocked, so edges the vote from Under Arrest who also looks capable of better on his first go over this trip. Dancing Dunes is another handicap debutant who commands plenty of respect.

  1. WELLS FARGOS ENVOY
  2. UNDER ARREST
  3. DANCING DUNES (GER)

races.name: Munich's Allianz-Grosser Preis Von Bayern Handicap
races.verdict:
GEORGE WICKHAM arrives on an upward curve and is taken to go one better after an excellent C&D second off a similar mark. Kennington scored comfortably over C&D last time and heads the list of dangers, although Gorgeous Mr George, Dwindling Funds and Tex can all play prominent roles, too.

  1. GEORGE WICKHAM (IRE)
  2. KENNINGTON
  3. GORGEOUS MR GEORGE (IRE)

races.name: Race 4 - Breeders' Cup Filly & Mare Sprint - Grade 1
Race 5 - Prevagen Breeders' Cup Turf Sprint - Grade 1
races.verdict:
BACIO made such a big impression racing in Europe earlier in the summer and, thanks to a good draw, can add another top-level success to his name. Comanche Brave has been an improved sprinter this season and can chase the selection home with last year's winner Shisospicy not one to be written off.

  1. BACIO (USA)
  2. COMANCHE BRAVE (IRE)
  3. SHISOSPICY (USA)

races.name: Race 6 - Breeders' Cup Dirt Mile - Grade 1
Race 7 - Maker's Mark Breeders' Cup Filly & Mare Turf - Grade 1
races.verdict:
The home team have a numerical advantage but it's the British/Irish raiders that have the edge on form, led by BLUE BLOT who is trying a new trip but boasts an unbeaten record this season. Precise has been maintaining a smart level of form and should be thereabouts again, while Jancis can back up her recent third in Canada.

  1. BLUE BOLT (IRE)
  2. PRECISE (IRE)
  3. JANCIS (IRE)

races.name: Race 8 - Cygames Breeders' Cup Sprint - Grade 1
Race 9 - FanDuel Breeders' Cup Mile Presented By PDJF - Grade 1
races.verdict:
NOTABLE SPEECH may be British trained but is a North American regular and can make it back-to-back Mile successes. Lake Forest, who was an unlucky loser over C&D last time, appeals as the biggest danger, from 4-time Grade 1 winner Deterministic, who represents the home team.

  1. NOTABLE SPEECH
  2. LAKE FOREST
  3. DETERMINISTIC (USA)

races.name: Race 10 - Longines Breeders' Cup Distaff - Grade 1
Race 11 - Longines Breeders' Cup Turf - Grade 1
races.verdict:
BAY CITY ROLLER has had a fine season and gets the vote to add another top-level success to his name. Diamond Necklace ran a fine third in the Arc last time, proving effective at this distance, and can chase the selection home from stablemate Benvenuto Cellini.

  1. BAY CITY ROLLER (IRE)
  2. DIAMOND NECKLACE (IRE)
  3. BENVENUTO CELLINI (IRE)

races.name: Race 12 - Longines Breeders' Cup Classic - Grade 1
races.verdict:
FOREVER YOUNG has fewer question marks against him than most and is the pick to become just the second horse to go back-to-back in the Classic. The Bill Mott/Godolphin combination have Sovereignty and Knightsbridge and they appeal as the most likely to fill the places.

  1. FOREVER YOUNG (JPN)
  2. SOVEREIGNTY (USA)
  3. KNIGHTSBRIDGE (USA)

races.name: Prix Claude Munet - Grand Prix D'angers Stakes
Prix Du Pays De Bray Handicap
Prix Du Pays De Caux Handicap
Prix Du Plateau De La Madrie Handicap
Prix De La Societe Du Trotteur Francais - Attele
Prix Du Comite Regional Du Trot - Attele
Prix De La Camargue _ Prix Geny Courses - Attele
Race 4 - James And Eleanor Casey Memorial Stakes
Race 9 - Golden State Juvenile Fillies Stakes
